patterns: Most frequent recall: Plan themes - 11th = 'Towards Faster and More Inclusive Growth', 12th = 'Faster, Sustainable and More Inclusive Growth' (asked repeatedly by APPSC, UPSC, UPPSC, RAS).

APPSC asks direct one-liners: three pillars of inclusive growth (Market Economics, Empowerment, Pragmatism), Sen's priority (primary education and health), AP Rural Inclusive Growth Project components (five).
Statement/code items (UPSC style) test what aids inclusive growth (SHGs, MSMEs, RTE all yes) and what is inclusive governance (DPCs, public health, mid-day meal; not NBFC banking).
Trap: inclusive growth is NOT expected from a high national-income growth rate alone.

App adds many current-figure MCQs (MSME shares, DAY-NRLM counts, VB-G RAM G) and table-mapping matches that are more granular than PYQ depth; AP-specific angle is thin compared with APPSC's APRIGP question.
